conventions.char_position_basis: 1-based Unicode code points within a segment's text
conventions.unicode: No Unicode normalisation and no simplified/traditional conversion is applied to the files.
conventions.variant_policy: Encoding decisions for variant forms (not a study of the variants). Recorded with their own code point, as printed: 来, 卽, 槪, 盖, 刋, 廼, 鈌, 攷, 亾, 揑, 矦, 衆, 狥, 愼, 横, 荆, 欵, 峯, 蕚, 埜, 栁, 緜, 帮, 猪, 擔 and 担 (each as printed), 釐 and 厘 (each as printed), 爲 and 為 (each as the page prints it), 並 and 并 (each as printed), 恒 (as printed, from p.[61]), 庄 (as printed, from p.[65]; not converted to 莊). Not distinguished, encoded with the usual traditional code point: 靑/青 (淸→清), 冃/曰 (冐→冒), 眞/真 in 塡 (→填) and standing alone (→真), 彦/彥 in 顏 (→顏, from p.[76]), 冖/宀 in 寇 (冦→寇, from p.[83]), 兪/俞 (→俞, from p.[92]), 没/沒 (→沒), 彔 top (録→錄), the middle of 徵, 丷/八 tops, 幷/并 (→并), a reduced printed form of 興 (→興), 厺/去 in 蓋 (→蓋, from p.[108]). Numerals in the accounts are often cut compactly, a digit stacked on 十, 百 or 千 inside one character cell (from p.[35]); they are always encoded as the separate characters they stand for. A unit's `ligatures` lists such cells only where the encoder recorded them; the list is not exhaustive.
conventions.space: A one-character honorific blank (擡頭空格) is a segment of kind 'space' holding U+3000. Inside the double-line note on p.[6] a blank separating two entries is kept as U+3000 within that segment. On donor-list pages the long blank between a donor's name (top of the column) and the amount (lower half) is also one 'space' segment holding a single U+3000, whatever its printed length.
conventions.double_line: Small side-by-side characters are a segment of kind double_line; linear order is right line then left line.
conventions.table_reading_order: Columns right to left; within a column top to bottom (upper entry, then lower entry); within an entry the name cell, then the right amount sub-column, then the left one.
conventions.txt: transcription-diplomatic.txt holds units with in_txt=true only, one unit (column or table entry) per line; pages are separated by a form feed (U+000C) in canvas order, so an empty page is an empty block. Table cells within one entry are separated by U+3000, and an honorific blank is also U+3000. Block-centre text, folios, library marks, stamps, show-through and fragments are kept in JSON/TEI only.
conventions.uncertain_char: □ (U+25A1) is an unresolved glyph or source fragment. It does not imply exactly one original character where the uncertainty record says extent=unknown; candidates are editorial proposals only.
conventions.bbox: Where given, zone-level boxes [x0,y0,x1,y1] in the page's coordinate_space, zero-based, right/bottom exclusive, approximate; no glyph-level coordinates.
conventions.folio: printed_folio is the leaf number printed in the block centre as read on that face; null where not visible.

Arithmetic as support only: 279,440 - 1,180 = 278,260 agrees with the printed figures, but the entries of pp.[63]-[64] as transcribed sum to 244,835 + 31,605 = 276,440 文, 3,000 less than the printed total. All thousands digits on both pages were re-examined in; the one reduced glyph (六 in 十六千 on p.[63]) is UNC-0048. The difference is not resolved and no character was changed to fit it. Block centre at the right edge; the heading of p.[65] (道光十七年錢業月捐數) is visible beyond the fold at the left and belongs to that page.

Arithmetic as support only: each count equals the length of its range (5353-5368 = 16, 5369-5385 = 17, 5386-5399 = 14, 5400-5405 = 6); with p.[95] the monthly counts sum to 95 + 53 = 148, as do the numbers 5258-5405, the printed total; 148 x 3,200 = 473,600 and 148 x 40 = 5,920, the printed totals; 20 x 40 = 800, the printed amount. The glyph under the ink blot in column 10 (UNC-0056) was not filled from the arithmetic or from column 7. Block centre at the right edge; text of the following page is visible beyond the fold at the left and belongs to that page.

observations.visible: 一條上起右斜、向左下走的長筆；其右有短折/竪及橫筆，與右部上緣靠近。沒有可獨立分隔而足以唯一指認午的完整上橫、下橫和穿豎。
observations.gold_candidate: 長斜筆與右方短折可與壓縮的人形屋頂相容；不能把這種解釋排除。
observations.fou_candidate: 可提出撇加橫豎的午形候選，但現有連墨不足把午完整分解出來。

observations.visible: 主要橫筆與中央竪相交，中央竪右另有一條短橫；短橫左側不完整。
observations.gold_candidate: 與王形分層橫豎相容，惟筆端有連墨/磨損，不能單憑此確定金。
observations.fou_candidate: 中央竪也可能屬缶，但不能由中央竪自動證成午凵。

observations.visible: 左側長豎樣墨筆、中央豎與向右上斜的底筆相接；右邊緊鄰覃的下部。未能在原生像素中清楚隔離金的兩點，也未能清楚隔離凵兩側與其上部的歸屬。
observations.gold_candidate: 拉長的點/挑及與橫豎相連的墨跡仍可能造成現有下部外觀，故不能排除金。
observations.fou_candidate: 下凵的輪廓候選存在，但其右側與覃連近；原QA將其直接定為山凵，證據不夠。

claim_by_claim_review.reason: 把初盲廬定為多認广，超出本幅能排除的範圍。全字左緣有外側長下行筆，內側另有由上橫下落的撇；外側筆與頂部橫段仍可構成廬候選的反證。這不能反過來證明廬唯一正確。

claim_by_claim_review.previous_claim: 頂中虍的豎筆高於左外撇
claim_by_claim_review.reason: 中央頂端墨筆高於外側左筆起點，是可見的相對位置。將這條墨筆全部歸屬虍、據其高度排除广，沒有足夠筆畫分界支持；頂端筆與下部豎勢連接，不能排除部件擠合或局部缺墨。

claim_by_claim_review.previous_claim: 未見另加广的點與覆蓋屋頂
claim_by_claim_review.reason: 未能分離一整套清晰的广點橫撇，不等於能證明沒有广。左外筆上端附近有向右橫段，頂右另有短橫／斜墨；其連屬關係不明。把這些全部指定為虍內筆、宣稱不存在屋頂，屬於過度斷言。
下部田形與皿形可辨；上部虍形的若干筆勢亦可見。然而盧／廬兩候選均容納這一內部構形，所以這些共同筆畫不能排除外加广。
原先保留初錄的結論不能由初錄、盲稿或模型彼此同意補足排他筆畫。建議本字改為待來源裁定，不修改任何已交付檔。

qa.checked_issue: 原圖能否唯一支持盧並排除廬？
qa.glyph_observation: 不能。外側左下行筆與頂部橫段足以阻止「無广」的排除性斷言，但筆畫連屬仍不足以唯一確認廬。

qa.checked_issue: 這是可確認的一字槽，還是字數未明的缺損群？
qa.glyph_observation: 可確認一個字槽。該整字的上界在義字之後，下界在工字之前；田、皿及上部筆畫均聚於同一個大字位置。未知在這一字的部件歸屬，不是多字範圍。故建議一個□、extent=1。

qa.checked_issue: 有沒有使用字義、條目名稱、其他書、算術或模型同意作原刻證據？
qa.glyph_observation: 沒有。只使用此幅官方來源的原生像素及其無重採樣裁圖；四倍最近鄰圖僅作顯示輔助，未增加原圖資訊。
